name: Z. Hyde
bio: Z. Hyde was foreman of the abattoir at Medora and the Cow Boy's first cash subscriber, and in February 1884 he gave the editor a tour of the plant. A hide buyer praised the condition of the abattoir's hides under him, and in April 1884 he brought his wife and children from Chicago to keep house at the Cantonment.
